name: Toxic Yuri
storyline:
What would you do if you found an abandoned sludge girl in a cardboard box? Take her home, of course!

Doku-chan is a sentient pile of sludge that used to stay hidden in alleyways until she met OL-san, an overworked office lady. But will things work out between them, or could this love be lethal?

Thus starts the most poisonous but fluffy yuri romance story you'll ever buy and play to completion.

Play through six devilish episodes. Depending on how nice or mean you are to Doku-chan, you'll get your official rating--TOXIC or TONIC, and the story changes drastically as a result. Can you live with the consequences of your actions? Yeah, I bet you can.
summary: An overworked office lady discovers a sludge girl abandoned in a box in an alleyway and takes her home. A poisonous and fluffy romance begins. Experience the most toxic love story the world has ever seen.
